@reconnecting.description: The home view's banner while a dropped session is retried.

@removeComputer.description: Context menu item on a home-view card, removing the saved connection.

@addComputer.description: The last card of the home view, and the title of its form.

lastConnected: Last connected {when, date, medium} {when, time, short}
usernamePlaceholder: If the server asks for one

@fetchClipboard.description: Session menu button: fetches the clipboard text the server announced into the local clipboard.

@downloadFile.description: Session menu button: opens the remote-path form for an ARD file download.

@downloadTitle.description: Title of the form asking for a path on the Mac and of its result alert.

@remotePath.description: Text field label: absolute path of the file or folder to download.

@downloadDone.description: Result alert after a file download.

@downloadFailed.description: Result alert when a file download fails.

err.example: rfb: file copy ended with error 5

secureOnly: Refuse None, VNC auth, Plain and other weak types

@dynamicResolution.description: Session panel and settings: the remote desktop's resolution follows the window's size, as in macOS Screen Sharing.

dynamicResolutionRefused: This computer cannot change its resolution, so the picture is scaled to fit the window.

@dynamicResolutionRefused.description: Session panel hint after the server refused dynamic resolution.

@statsDropped.description: Stats HUD, High Performance: pictures decoded but not shown.

@highPerformance.description: Settings: ask a Mac for its HEVC/H.264 media stream; applies on (re)connect.

@videoDecoding.description: Settings: where High Performance and H.264 video is decoded; applies on (re)connect. Choices: Auto, videoDecodingHardware, videoDecodingSoftware.

@decoderHardware.description: Stats HUD and session panel: video is decoded on this GPU.

@decoderFallback.description: Video decoding was asked of the GPU but falls back to the CPU.

hpOtherViewer: High Performance unavailable: another viewer is using this Mac's High Performance stream. Using Standard mode.
hpNoMedia: High Performance media did not arrive. A router with NAT between this PC and the Mac is likely blocking it (the Mac sends UDP 5900/5901 to the address it sees). Using Standard mode.
hpNoDecoder: High Performance unavailable: this PC has no {codec} decoder (for HEVC, install the HEVC Video Extensions). Using Standard mode.
hpRefused: High Performance unavailable: the Mac refused the media stream (error type {type}, sub-code {code}). Using Standard mode.
hpUnavailable: High Performance unavailable: {reason}. Using Standard mode.

@statsLink.description: Throughput estimate and fence round trip; rtt is a dash before one is measured.

statsRequested: Asked {name}{auto, select, yes { (auto)} other {}}, quality {quality}, {colour, select, full {full colour} other {256 colours}}

@statsRequested.description: What MyVNC asks the server for: preferred encoding, JPEG quality level (a dash for none), colour depth.

@titleSession.description: The title bar during a session: desktop name, app, security type, encryption.

hostKeyMessage: This is the first connection to {addr}. Its key fingerprint is {fingerprint}. Make sure it is the server's before you accept.
unencryptedMessage: {addr} uses {kind}: the password and everything you type are not protected from anyone on the network between you and the server.
errUnencryptedCanceled: Canceled: the connection is not encrypted.
